gap_description: QR code generator, Generate QR codes for URLs, text, WiFi config. Simple, no external APIs, easy to stash or and canvas or send via email.
purpose: Fill the gap of QR code generation - no external APIs needed, pure Python library, outputs to stash for downstream use
capabilities: Generate QR code for any URL
Generate QR code for plain text
Generate QR code for WiFi network config (SSID, password, security type)
Generate QR code for email addresses
Save stash ref to memory for follow-up queries

parameters.type: Type of QR code: 'text' for plain text, 'url' for websites, 'wifi' for WiFi network config, 'email' for email addresses. Defaults to 'text'.
parameters.content: The content to encode. For text/url/email types, put the value here. For wifi, you can put the SSID here or use the ssid parameter.
parameters.ssid: WiFi network name (SSID). Required for type='wifi'.
parameters.password: WiFi password. Used for type='wifi'. Leave empty for open networks.
parameters.security: WiFi security type: 'WPA' (default), 'WEP', or 'nopass' for open networks. Used for type='wifi'.
parameters.hidden: Whether the WiFi network is hidden. Default false. Used for type='wifi'.
parameters.filename: Optional custom filename for the saved PNG. Auto-generated if not provided.
parameters.box_size: Pixels per QR module/box. Default 10. Higher = larger image.
parameters.border: Border width in QR modules. Default 4 (QR spec minimum).
